author: IGN
description:
You don't have to wait until Diablo 5 and its 2029 release date to face off against Diablo, the Lord of Terror. Instead, Diablo 4's Season 15 seeks to inject a bit of nostalgia by bringing all three prime evils together in a sort of boss rush mode. Take a trip down memory lane as Deckard Cain makes a surprise comeback to talk Diablo lore as you descened through hell to face off against Diablo.

#ign #gaming
title: Diablo Himself Returns in Diablo 4 | Season 15 Gameplay

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Transformers Add-On Trailer for Minecraft, the hit creation adventure game developed by Mojang. Players will be able to morph into one of 12 characters, including Optimus Prime and Megatron, each with unique abilities, weapons, and vehicles. Take on players in three different battle modes, like Deathmatch or Last Man Standing. The Transformers Add-On is available now on Minecraft.

#ign #gaming
title: Minecraft - Official Transformers Add-On Trailer

author: IGN
description: Check out the Alkimya: House of Wisdom announcement trailer for this upcoming first-person survival horror game set in the House of Wisdom during the 1258 siege of Baghdad. Scavenge for resources, craft alchemical flasks, unlock an interconnected sanctum of Golden Age puzzles, and survive the Mongol invaders — and the cosmic horror waiting beneath them. Alkimya: House of Wisdom will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) and PlayStation.
title: Alkimya: House of Wisdom - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Discover the secrets of Azeroth’s newest playable race, harness powers yet unseen, and take new first steps through lands untrodden when World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4, 2026. Or, uncover Azeroth’s mysteries early by playing in the WoW: Forever Beta starting September 17, 2026, when you pre-purchase the Skyborne Epic Pack or the Warcraft Forever Collection.

#ign #gaming
title: World of Warcraft: Forever - Official Gameplay Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: IGN
description:
Built as a new permanent home alongside modern and Classic WoW, World of Warcraft: Forever invites past, current, and new players into a familiar yet fresh Azeroth where the world takes center stage, community comes first, and the journey matters as much as the destination. Set after the events of Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom and before Molten Core, players will return to the original continents, adventure to level 60, and continue progressing through new stories, experiences, and updates inspired by years of player passion and feedback. World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4, with beta beginning Thursday, September 17.

#ign #gaming
title: World of Warcraft: Forever - Official New Horizons Cinematic Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: IGN
description:
Return to the Last Days of Lordaeron to experience the fall of one great city and play a part in the founding of another.  Test your strategic mettle and meet heroes familiar and new across over 30 hours of new campaign content.  Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom launches today.

#ign #gaming
title: Warcraft III: Reforged Forsaken Kingdom - Official Gameplay Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: IGN
description:
For the first time in more than two decades, a new campaign has arrived in Warcraft III: Reforged. Forsaken Kingdom follows the fall of Lordaeron and its transformation into becoming the Undercity, introducing new faces alongside familiar figures, like Sylvanas, as players discover what it truly means to be Forsaken.

#ign #gaming
title: Warcraft III: Reforged Forsaken Kingdom - Official Launch Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: IGN
description:
The Last Titan is more than a return to Northrend—it’s a reflection on generations of courage, sacrifice, and unforgettable deeds across Azeroth. From the Shifting Sands of Ahn’Qiraj to the Frozen Throne, the Worldbreaker, the Burning Legion, and even the realms beyond life and death, heroes have fought time and again to defend our home. As Azeroth calls on us one last time, this next chapter will offer a glimpse at the challenges waiting ahead when more is revealed early next year, after the events of Midnight: Eclipse.

#ign #gaming
title: World of Warcraft - Official The Last Titan Teaser Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: IGN
description:
The next major content update for Midnight, Eclipse, brings players face-to-face with Xal’atath as she hovers just within reach of her ultimate objective: the Worldsoul. With Azeroth’s fate hanging in the balance, players will need to confront her directly and stop her from claiming victory. The events of Eclipse will unfold in the worldcore, setting the stage for a revelation and conflict that will carry the Worldsoul Saga toward its final chapter in The Last Titan.

#ign #gaming
title: World of Warcraft Midnight: Eclipse - Official Reveal Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Heavy Bowgun Boosted Action in this latest Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance trailer for the upcoming action RPG expansion. The new trailer spotlights the Heavy Bowgun and breaks down its Boosted Action, featuring the Boosted Compression Cannon, loading & firing overcharged rounds, and reduced recoil. Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.

#gaming #ign
title: Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance - Official Heavy Bowgun Boosted Action Trailer

author: IGN
description: Zach Cregger, a longtime fan of the Resident Evil games, and Austin Abrams sit down with IGN's Tom Jorgensen to explain the upcoming adaptation's approach to honoring the world of the games without explicitly retelling any of the same story beats the games have covered, how Cregger underestimated how badly fans wanted to see Leon Kennedy in a starring role, and how important it was to deliver an "adrenalized" momentum the entire way through.
title: "I Was Naive" | Resident Evil's Zach Cregger Underestimated Fans' Hunger for Leon's Story

author: IGN
description:
Join Volker Steigerwald from the SWE Systems development team as he takes you through 12 minutes of gameplay from their upcoming game Professional Ship Simulator, in which you'll helm everything from tugboats to cargo freighters to yachts while navigating dynamic weather and realistic physics using authentic ship systems. It will be released in Early Access for PC on September 16. You can wishlist it or download the playable demo now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636930/Professional_Ship_Simulator/

#IGN #Gaming
title: Professional Ship Simulator: Official Gameplay Explainer

author: IGN
description:
Nintendo showed roughly 20 minutes of The Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time remake gameplay during the Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct. Producer Eiji Aonuma said this project is largely a faithful remake of the N64 classic, reborn on Switch 2 with modern controls and a strong focus on detail. But even though the Ocarina remake appears to stick closely to the bones of its source material, there are plenty of minor additions and changes we noticed when scrubbing back through the footage for a couple of hours following the Direct. Here are 40 changes we saw when comparing Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 to the N64 version, from things as large as the art style all the way to small menu changes and UI differences.

#IGN #Gaming #Nintendo
title: The 40 Biggest Changes in the Zelda: Ocarina of Time Gameplay

Presented by Zeverland. Wishlist now!
title: Zeverland Allows You to Craft Your Own Zombie Once You Become Infected | gamescom 2026
